title: Density ratios are bounded by the ball-mass constant about 0 (printed 5.5(2))
statement: Let μ be a measure on ℝ^N, n ∈ ℕ and a ∈ [0,∞]. Write R(y,ρ) := densityRatio n μ y ρ = μ(B_ρ(y))/(ω·ofReal(ρ)^n), with B_ρ the closed ball and ω = unitBallVolume n. Suppose (i) for every y ∈ ℝ^N, ρ ↦ R(y,ρ) is non-decreasing on (0,∞), and (ii) μ(B_ρ(0)) = a·ω·ofReal(ρ)^n for every ρ > 0. Then R(y,ρ) ≤ a for every y ∈ ℝ^N and every ρ > 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (a : ℝ≥0∞), (∀ y : Euclidean N, MonotoneOn (densityRatio n μ y) (Ioi 0)) → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → μ (closedBall 0 ρ) = a * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) → ∀ (y : Euclidean N) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → densityRatio n μ y ρ ≤ a
